translations.web: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.
translations.bsb: Though I am free of obligation to anyone, I make myself a slave to everyone, to win as many as possible.
translations.kjv: For though I be free from all men, yet have I made ➔ myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.
translations.asv: For though I was free from all men, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.
